mapper.select: SELECT ci.dish_id AS dishId, d.dish_name AS dishName, ci.unit_price AS unitPrice, ci.quantity AS quantity, ci.selected AS selected FROM cart_item ci INNER JOIN dish d ON ci.dish_id = d.id WHERE ci.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY ci.id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cart_item (user_id, dish_id, quantity, unit_price, selected) VALUES (#{userId}, #{dishId}, #{quantity}, #{unitPrice}, #{selected})
mapper.update: UPDATE cart_item SET quantity = #{quantity} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM cart_item WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND dish_id = #{dishId}
